answer_2.quote: We employ the UTMOS automatic Mean Opinion Score (MOS) prediction system... we also adopt the metrics from speech enhancement fields, such as the PESQ, STOI, and the F1 score for voiced/unvoiced classification... we also evaluate speaker similarity (SPK) using WavLM-TDNN and word error rate (WER) using a HuBERT-Large ASR model.

answer_4.quote: We conduct the MOS (mean opinion score) evaluation on the Librispeech test set to measure the audio naturalness via crowdsourcing in zero-shot TTS experiments... we also performed subjective CMOS tests... The MOS and CMOS evaluations involve human raters rating audio quality and similarity.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters were asked to rate the naturalness of the synthesized audio (MOS) and to compare audio quality and speaker similarity (CMOS).
